descriptions.value: In multiple locations, there is a possible way to corrupt host allocator metadata in shared memory due to memory corruption. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In EuiccPort.buildUiccAccessRule of EuiccPort.java, there is a possible Confused Deputy due to a confused deputy. This could lead to remote escalation of privilege with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.

In handleEvent of gscan.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write on the heap due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
